note: Curated models and recommendation shortlists for Omni. `keys` are editorial choices, ordered best first; the first signed-in provider wins. They are not benchmark rankings. `models` contains one row per provider, model, and effort. Explicit model IDs still pass through even when absent here. Missing measurements stay null. Legacy options remain selectable by name; current recommendations do not use them.

fields.provider: which inference adapter runs it: claude-code-cli, codex-app-server, antigravity-cli
fields.model: passed to the CLI verbatim. it does not have to exist in any catalogue
fields.effort: passed to the CLI verbatim. "" means the flag is not passed at all
fields.price: USD per Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3 task; null means unmeasured.
fields.secs: Seconds per Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3 task; null means unmeasured.
fields.scores: Benchmark ID to measured score; missing measurements are not ranked.
fields.status: current: recommended generation; legacy: retained for explicit selection; restricted: requires additional access. Status does not prove account access.
fields.sources: Official documentation URLs supporting model identity, effort, lifecycle, or price; these do not replace the historical benchmark source.
fields.notes: Model or provider access details and recommendation context.
fields.api_pricing: First-party standard API USD per 1M tokens, as of the catalog date. Separate from measured per-task price and CLI subscription usage.

source.benchmark: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3, GDPval-AA v2, Terminal-Bench 4.0
source.score: Elo from blind pairwise judging of complete work deliverables over 220 GDPval tasks in an agentic harness, anchored so a human expert scores 1000. 95% CIs run about +/-15 to +/-27, so gaps under ~35 Elo are not separable.
source.price: USD per Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3 task; null means unmeasured.
source.secs: Seconds per Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3 task; null means unmeasured.
source.design: Design Arena, Full Stack leaderboard, per-criteria average. Captured 2026-08-25 from https://www.designarena.ai/leaderboard/fullstack
source.research: Agents' Last Exam, Score (average partial credit) for the best effort each harness publishes. Captured 2026-08-25 from https://agents-last-exam.org/leaderboard

caveats: Keyword shortlists are curated recommendations, not cross-provider benchmark winners. No Omni head-to-head evaluation has established a universal best model.
Existing benchmark, per-task price, and timing measurements are preserved from the September 2026 import. They were not rerun during the October catalog update.
New model rows have null scores, price, and secs until comparable measurements are captured. Vendor launch benchmarks are not mixed with the older benchmark versions or harnesses.
API token prices are separate from per-task benchmark costs and subscription limits. Long-context, caching, speed tiers, and regional processing can change API pricing.

A signed-in provider does not guarantee access to every model. The installed Codex model cache and Antigravity model list were checked on 2026-10-15; Claude Code account access was not probed with inference.
GPT-5.6 options remain available for explicit selection. GPT-5.5 is retired for ChatGPT-authenticated Codex; API-key sessions are unaffected.
Astra ultra is supported by the local app server but has no separately measured row here; its score is not inferred from max.
Gemini 4 Argon is available on eligible Antigravity plans but absent from the checked account model list, so it is not a default or fallback here.
